name: West Kennet Long Barrow
summary: The West Kennet Long Barrow, also known as South Long Barrow, is a chambered long barrow near the village of Avebury in the south-western English county of Wiltshire. Probably constructed in the thirty-seventh century BC, during Britain's Early Neolithic period. Today it survives in a partially reconstructed state.
aka: West Kennet Long Barrow, 800m south-east of Silbury Hill, West Kennet long barrow
